knowledge:
- key_parameters: recalibrator=Sets the functions to use for recalibration (e.g., list(MS1="recalibrate.loess", MS2="recalibrate.loess") or "recalibrate.identity" to skip recalibration) ;; recalibrateBy=Determines whether to recalibrate by ppm deviation ("dppm") or absolute m/z deviation ("dmz") ;; recalibrateMS1=Controls whether to recalibrate MS1 data separately ("separate"), with the same curve as MS2 ("common"), or not at all ("none") ;; multiplicityFilter=Defines the multiplicity filtering level (default is 2, 1 is off, >2 is harsher filtering) ;; prelimCut=Intensity cut-off for pre-processing peak selection prior to recalibration ;; confirmMode=Integer parameter in msmsWorkflow (e.g., confirmMode = 1) used to retrieve the second-best (confirmation) spectra for combining multiplicities ;; accessionBuilderType=Determines how to generate MassBank record accession numbers ("standard", "simple", or "selfDefined")
- alternatives: OpenBabel vs CACTUS=OpenBabel is highly recommended and preferred for generating high-quality MOL files with implicit hydrogens; CACTUS is a web-service backup solution used automatically if OpenBabel is not installed or configured.
- when_to_use: Appropriate when processing high-resolution LC-MS/MS data (from instruments like Orbitrap or TOF) to clean, recalibrate, and annotate spectra for submission to a MassBank database.
- pitfalls: file_naming=Raw LC-MS files must be named exactly in the format xxxxxxxx_1234_xxx.mzML, where "1234" is the compound ID matching the compound list ;; compound_list_columns=The compound list CSV must contain at least the columns ID, Name, SMILES, RT, and CAS, even if some columns are left empty ;; prelimCut_defaults=The default prelimCut value of 1e4 is optimized for Orbitrap LTQ positive mode and may remove all peaks for TOF data or too many peaks for Orbitrap LTQ negative mode spectra ;; multiplicity_filtering_loss=Multiplicity filtering can erroneously delete real peaks that only appear in the highest or lowest collision energies; using combineMultiplicities with confirmation spectra prevents this ;; logging_file_setting=Changing the logging_file setting manually in R after loading settings will not change the active log file because it is stored in a static package variable checked by logging functions.

workflows.name: msms_spectral_processing
workflows.intent: Extract, analyze, recalibrate, and filter MS/MS spectra from raw LC-MS data files.
input: Compoundlist.csv (CSV file containing compound IDs, SMILES, and retention times)
raw_spectra.mzML (raw centroid or profile LC-MS/MS data files)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate and load settings using RmbSettingsTemplate and loadRmbSettings ;; 2. Initialize workspace using newMsmsWorkspace and load the compound list using loadList ;; 3. Run msmsWorkflow steps 1 to 4 to extract spectra, attempt formula fitting, aggregate peaks, and calculate the recalibration curve ;; 4. Plot and inspect the recalibration curve using plotRecalibration ;; 5. Run msmsWorkflow steps 5 to 8 to re-analyze recalibrated spectra, aggregate, clean electronic noise, re-analyze failed peaks, and apply multiplicity filtering.
workflows.code:
RmbSettingsTemplate("mysettings.ini")
loadRmbSettings("mysettings.ini")
w <- newMsmsWorkspace()
files <- list.files(system.file("spectra", package="RMassBankData"),
	 ".mzML", full.names = TRUE)
basename(files)
w@files <- files[1:2]
loadList("./Compoundlist.csv")
w <- msmsWorkflow(w, mode="pH", steps=c(1:4), archivename = 
				"pH_narcotics")
storedW <- loadMsmsWorkspace(system.file("results/pH_narcotics_RF.RData", 
				package="RMassBankData"))
storedW <- msmsWorkflow(storedW, mode="pH", steps=4)
w@rc <- storedW@parent@rc
w@rc.ms1 <- storedW@parent@rc.ms1
w <- msmsWorkflow(w, mode="pH", steps=4, archivename = 
	"pH_narcotics", newRecalibration = FALSE)
w <- msmsWorkflow(w, mode="pH", steps=c(5:8), archivename = 
		"pH_narcotics")

workflows.name: multiplicity_filtering_workflow
workflows.intent: Combine peak multiplicities from standard and confirmation spectra runs to prevent erroneous deletion of low-occurrence peaks.
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize default settings and define the spectra list ;; 2. Load the compound list and initialize the workspace ;; 3. Run msmsWorkflow steps 1 to 7 for the primary spectra ;; 4. Run msmsWorkflow steps 1 to 7 for the confirmation spectra (using confirmMode = 1) ;; 5. Combine the workspaces using combineMultiplicities ;; 6. Run msmsWorkflow step 8 on the combined workspace to apply multiplicity filtering.
workflows.code:
RmbDefaultSettings()
getOption("RMassBank")$multiplicityFilter
rmbo <- getOption("RMassBank")
rmbo$spectraList <- list(
    list(mode="CID", ces = "35%", ce = "35 % (nominal)", res = 7500),
    list(mode="HCD", ces = "15%", ce = "15 % (nominal)", res = 7500),
    list(mode="HCD", ces = "30%", ce = "30 % (nominal)", res = 7500)
)
options(RMassBank = rmbo)
loadList(system.file("list/NarcoticsDataset.csv", 
        package="RMassBankData"))
w <- newMsmsWorkspace()
files <- list.files(system.file("spectra", package="RMassBankData"),
        ".mzML", full.names = TRUE)
w@files <- files[1:2]
w1 <- msmsWorkflow(w, mode="pH", steps=c(1))
w1@spectra <- as(lapply(w1@spectra, function(s)
    {
		s@children <- s@children[1:3]
		s
    }),"SimpleList")
w1 <- msmsWorkflow(w1, mode="pH", steps=c(2:7))
w2 <- msmsWorkflow(w, mode="pH", steps=c(1), confirmMode = 1)
w2@spectra <- as(lapply(w2@spectra, function(s)
    {
		s@children <- s@children[1:3]
		s
    }),"SimpleList")
w2 <- msmsWorkflow(w2, mode="pH", steps=c(2:7))
wTotal <- combineMultiplicities(c(w1, w2))
wTotal <- msmsWorkflow(wTotal, steps=8, mode="pH", archivename = "output")

workflows.name: massbank_record_generation
workflows.intent: Retrieve compound annotations, compile spectral data, and export standardized MassBank records.
input: Narcotics_infolist.csv (CSV file to write and edit compound annotations)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize a MassBank workspace from the processed MS/MS workspace using newMbWorkspace ;; 2. Load existing incomplete infolists using loadInfolists ;; 3. Run mbWorkflow to fetch missing annotations from online databases (CTS) and write them to a CSV file ;; 4. Manually edit and complete the generated CSV infolist ;; 5. Reload the completed infolists and re-run mbWorkflow to compile records, generate molfiles, and export MassBank record text files.
workflows.code:
mb <- newMbWorkspace(w)
mb <- resetInfolists(mb)
mb <- loadInfolists(mb, system.file("infolists_incomplete",
		package="RMassBankData"))
mb <- mbWorkflow(mb, infolist_path="./Narcotics_infolist.csv")
mb <- resetInfolists(mb)
mb <- loadInfolists(mb, system.file("infolists", package="RMassBankData"))
mb <- mbWorkflow(mb)
